name: Peg Shar I
description: Peg Shar I was an industrial world in the Peg Shar system of the Halla sector in the Mid Rim Territories and the Slice. It fell within grid square R-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid. It was represented by a senator in the Senate of the Galactic Republic by 32 BBY. That year, the senator for the world had an office in a lower level of the Galactic Senate Building on the Republic capital, Coruscant.
